description.zh:
匹配模式，默认为fuzzy模糊匹配。取值：

- fuzzy： 模糊
- precise：精确，该模式仅对新增媒资生效。
description.en:
Matching pattern. The default value is fuzzy for Fuzzy Matching. Valid values:

- fuzzy: Fuzzy Matching

- precise: Precise matching. This pattern applies only to newly added media assets.
The ID of the media asset. This parameter is required if you want to query media asset clips.

description.zh:
媒资类型。取值：
- image：图片
- video：视频
- audio：音频
description.en:
The type of the media assets. Valid values:

- image

- video

- audio

description.zh:
多模搜索类型。默认为全文搜索。取值：

- PersonName：人名搜
- Ocr：字幕搜
- AiCategory ：AI分类
- FullSearch：全文搜
description.en:
The type of query. Valid values:

- PersonName: queries media assets based on character names.

- Ocr: queries media assets based on subtitles.

- AiCategory: queries media assets based on AI categories.

- FullSearch (default): queries all media assets.

description.zh: 每页返回的数据条数。默认值为10，最大值为50。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50.
The name of the search library.

description.zh:
查询结果排序。取值：

- CreationTime:Desc（默认值）：按创建时间倒序。
- CreationTime:Asc：按创建时间升序。
description.en:
The sorting method of the results. Valid values:

- CreationTime:Desc (default): sorts results in reverse chronological order.

- CreationTime:Asc: sorts results in chronological order.

description.zh:
是否精搜。取值：

- true： 精搜
- false：粗搜
description.en:
Specifies whether to query media asset clips. Valid values:

- true

- false
The content that you want to query.

description.zh:
创建时间，毫秒时间戳。gte大于等于，lte小于等于。
- 范围，如{"gte":1761205662998,"lte":1771205662998}
description.en:
Creation time, in milliseconds UNIX timestamp. Use gte for greater than or equal to, and lte for less than or equal to.

- Example range: {"gte":1761205662998,"lte":1771205662998}

title.en: DataQ - Smart Tag Service Text Search

descriptions.zh: 可以根据人名、字幕、AI分类进行多模搜索，粗搜支持媒资粒度返回，精搜支持媒资内命中片段信息返回。
descriptions.en: You can perform multimodal search based on person names, captions, and AI categorization. Coarse search supports returning results at the media asset granularity, while fine search supports returning hit segment information within media assets.
